questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with People's Republic of China?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture People's Republic of China on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: It borders Vietnam, Laos, and Burma in Southeast Asia; India, Bhutan, Nepal and Pakistan in South Asia; Afghanistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan in Central Asia; a small section of Russian Altai and Mongolia in Inner Asia; and the Russian Far East and North Korea in Northeast Asia.

questions.prompt: Which continent is People's Republic of China in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find People's Republic of China on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find People's Republic of China on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.proof: People's Republic of China is in Asia.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of People's Republic of China?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the People's Republic of China article.

questions.proof: The capital city is Beijing and Shanghai is the city with the most people living in it.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: People's Republic of China about 9,562,910 square kilometres; Venezuela about 912,050 square kilometres; Turkmenistan about 491,210 square kilometres; Papua New Guinea about 462,840 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Beijing?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of People's Republic of China is Beijing.
